name: Regional S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Regional S.A.B. de C.V. provides various banking products and services. It operates through the Wholesale, Retail Banking, and Leasing segments. The company offers loans for working capital or investment projects. It also provides financial services and products, such as loans, point-of-sale terminals, insurance products, and other products for small businesses and entrepreneurs, as well as credit cards, personal loans, and mortgages. In addition, the company offers financial leasing services for the acquisition of machinery and equipment, forklifts, computers, and auto fleets. Regional S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1994 and is based in San Pedro Garza Garcia, Mexico.
